_README: STAND-IN weekend watcher config, written 2026-09-15 so the window is covered.
Rakha's readiness config sets warnMinutes: 30. Since #169 the warn tier is
floored at WORST_OBSERVED_SCHEDULER_GAP_MINUTES (369), so that policy is
rejected and the watcher would throw on startup — for the whole weekend,
including Sunday. Its window opens Fri 2026-09-18 00:00 UTC.
This exists so the weekend is covered without waiting on anyone. Rakha should
replace it with his own numbers if he prefers different ones; then delete this.
Only warnMinutes differs from his: 30 -> 420. It sits between the two floors —
above the worst gap we have measured (369), below the bound we will not accept
(480). criticalMinutes 540 already cleared its floor and is unchanged.
stateRoot is repo-relative and gitignored, so either Rakha or the fallback
operator in SEP-20-PREFLIGHT.md 5b can run this. His own config points at an
absolute path on his machine; that is fine for him and unusable for anyone else.
The evidence bundle at docs/evidence/2026-09-15-readiness/watch.json is NOT
edited. It is a checksummed record of what was configured, and rewriting a
record to match a later decision is the one thing this repo does not do.
